cards.next_smallest_test: Do not enlarge a finite matrix. Freeze a genuinely infinite-memory or infinite-dimensional symbolic model with an independent A0 source, then re-evaluate it as a new candidate.
No further Artin-Mazur test is warranted. Any zeta based on aperiodic statistics is a different observable and requires a new source lock.
Only evaluate a new renewal proposal after all return weights arise from a preregistered low-description-complexity grammar and composite, pseudoprime, and matched-density controls are fixed.
Pre-register any proposed word-to-prime map and test it against exact trace collisions, neighboring digits, shuffled words, and composite discriminants before any determinant comparison.
Prove or refute a stationary natural extension of comparable description complexity that retains the recursion without reset edges or prime-indexed components.
Construct or rule out a canonical primitive-cycle map for the frozen binary recursion and test whether a pre-existing symmetry produces the sign before any analytic target comparison.
